import pathlib, sys
OLD = 'submit PURLs in batches of at most 40 to `license-compliance/package-checks` ([license compliance API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/license-compliance)); when a lookup fails only because of a `repository_url` qualifier, retry once without it and log both responses.'
NEW = "check PURLs with `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/license-compliance/package-checks`, in batches of at most 40, against that repository's policy, and read the enterprise policy with `GET /enterprises/{enterprise}/license-compliance/policies/default`, the only policy identifier the API accepts; the API has no package check at the organization or enterprise level ([license compliance API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/dependency-graph/license-compliance)). A Maven PURL that the SBOM emits with a `repository_url` qualifier comes back `unknown` and resolves without the qualifier: retry that PURL once without it and keep both responses (observed behavior, not described in GitHub's documentation, recorded in `LCV-574`)."
for f in ("AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md"):
    p = pathlib.Path(f); s = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", newline="")
    n = s.count(OLD)
    if n != 1: raise SystemExit(f"{f}: anchor count {n}")
    p.write_text(s.replace(OLD, NEW), encoding="utf-8", newline="")
a = pathlib.Path("AGENTS.md").read_bytes(); c = pathlib.Path("CLAUDE.md").read_bytes()
if a != c: raise SystemExit("AGENTS.md != CLAUDE.md after edit")
print("edited ok")
--- commit-msg ---
docs(agents): state the repository package-check path in the licensing rule

Name `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/license-compliance/package-checks` and the
enterprise policy identifier `default` in Section 7.B, point the link at the
license compliance API page, and mark the `repository_url` retry as observed
behavior recorded in LCV-574. Refs LCV-591.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
